scoring.contrast: Report both within-mode deltas; delta_bf16 minus delta_checkpoint is descriptive, not a significance test.
scoring.supported_if_checkpoint_regresses_and_bf: For this fixed row, initialization, one-step optimizer recipe and pinned runtime, bypassing the specified differentiable-path activation quantizer bundle changed the observed outcome from regression to descent.
scoring.if_checkpoint_descends: The new matched control does not reproduce the claimed failure; do not claim the quantizer bundle was necessary to restore descent. Investigate historical source/environment or nondeterminism.
scoring.if_checkpoint_unresolved: No resolved checkpoint direction within the predeclared band; report that result without a regression claim.
not_supported: A unique quantizer or STE is proven responsible
Treatment has better absolute base quality
